
## Conditional LGTM

- [ ] The code changes have been reviewed.
- [ ] Relevant automated tests are passing, or are still pending.
- [ ] Required CI checks must pass before merging.
- [ ] Any failing test or security check must be resolved before merging.
- [ ] If new commits change the reviewed code, the changes must be reviewed again.

### Reviewer decision
- [ ] **Conditional LGTM** — code review is complete; merge only after all required checks pass.
- [ ] **Changes requested** — changes are needed before approval.
- [ ] **Further review needed** — the implementation needs additional review.

### Verification evidence
- Tests run:
- Pending checks:
- Known risks:
